response.justification: MOC-2005-0091 was raised at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station on 3 October 2005 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-ELE-026 and STD-ELE-009.
